$comment: Orcivo orchestration SECURITY SPINE (V2) config. V2 is a clean-room rebuild after the independent review REJECTED V1, then a second review REJECTED the V1 spine. This file holds knobs, NEVER status. V2 runtime state lives under .orchestration/v2/ and is authoritative for V2 only. V1 runtime state is never read by V2. Nothing here is controllable by a task spec.

ledger.$comment: C-01: WAITING_HUMAN is NOT dispatchable - a task parked for a human is resumed only by an explicit gate approval event, never by the scheduler. Any ledger corruption -> QUARANTINED (fail closed), never a 'plausible' rebuild.

contract.$comment: H-06/M-01: an empty declaredScope FAILS CLOSED (no changed file is in scope). An unrestricted executor needs the explicit risk-C grant 'unrestrictedScope', which is a different thing from []. H3-05: a protectedPathGrant MUST be an exact canonical member of grantableProtectedPrefixes - no globs, no root, no parent, no 'whole .planning'. A task can never invent a new protected prefix.

preflight.$comment: M3-03: the fetch observation is in-process authority only. Invoke-PreflightFetch mints a session token; Test-Preflight requires the exact in-memory object, performed=true, exit 0, correct remote/target/beforeSHA, a non-empty freshly-observed remote SHA, and NO 'NO_REMOTE' dispatch path. A writable last-fetch.json is audit-only and never authority. #9: the derived index entry must agree with the frozen contract on taskId, gate and dependencies - a derived index can never weaken a frozen contract.

limits.$comment: C-02/H-03: hard bounds enforced BEFORE and DURING schema validation. Anything over the bound fails closed to HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.

verification.$comment: NH-02: verification is DECLARATIVE and lives here, outside any task. A task names a profileId; it cannot supply commands, executables, args, cwd or env. The frozen contract binds verificationDefinitionHash = canonical hash of the resolved profile object below.

A.description: docs / copy / fixture - structural checks only, no build

B.description: contained code change - structural + lint-shape checks (no network)

C.description: security / tenant / money / schema - full checks, human gate required elsewhere

classification.$comment: H-01: provider failover is allowed ONLY for these classes, and ONLY when the class comes from the CLI's own structured control channel - never from application/task/test stdout.

leases.$comment: H-05: a lease whose holder process is provably alive is NEVER an orphan, regardless of heartbeat age. A stale heartbeat alone quarantines the lease record; it does not hand the key to a second writer.

gates.$comment: #13: on read, gateHash is recomputed over {gateId, taskVersionId, specHash, decision, approvalIdentity, approvalTimestamp, nonce}. Synthetic approvals are permitted ONLY from the isolated test harness (Assert-DisposableRoot).

redaction.$comment: H3-02: ONE canonical secret library. `secretPatterns` is used identically by the streaming redactor (Protect-Line), the sanitize-before-write path, the pre-publication scan gate AND the final artifact sweep. `multilinePatterns` is the stateful PEM buffer. Every value-capturing pattern includes its key/prefix in the match so a `[REDACTED]` replacement removes the trigger and a redacted artifact scans clean.
